handbookNote: Delaware Driver Manual, Delaware Division of Motor Vehicles (dmv.de.gov/forms/driver_serv_forms/pdfs/dr_frm_manual.pdf) -- current edition, internally dated July 2026, fetched and extracted directly from the official PDF on 2026-08-16 (full text saved to temp/handbooks/de/driver.txt). Real exam mechanics CONFIRMED from the DMV's own Driver License General FAQ (dmv.de.gov/DriverServices/faqs/index.shtml?dc=dr_faq_general): the Delaware knowledge test has 30 questions, of which at least 24 must be answered correctly to pass (an 80% passing threshold). The manual does not publish a time limit for the knowledge test and no official source states one was found, so timed/untimed is left unconfirmed rather than guessed. This is a rich, detailed 147-page manual (definitions, GDL/licensing, DUI law, vehicle equipment/registration/insurance, full rules-of-the-road with signs/signals/markings, right-of-way, roundabouts, school buses, parking, speed, sharing the road with pedestrians/bicycles/motorcycles/trucks, and a full driving-skills/safety/emergencies section) that comfortably supports a large, non-repetitive question bank -- price matches this project's established Driver tier ($4.99), not a placeholder. Every question in this bank is grounded in a specific, cited passage of the fetched official manual text or the official FAQ page; none are invented or generic 'common knowledge' items.
